description:
FOUND s499h (Opus, 2026-09-27) grepping t/re/re_tests for #2444's `{,n}` rows (re_tests line 49: `\N{ 3 , 4 }	abbbbc	y	$+[0]	4`).  PRE-EXISTING (main da10ea22 and the s499h tree alike).

Reproducer (scratch/s499h/q2.pl in the s499h worktree):
    print(("abbbbc" =~ /\N{3,4}/) ? "$&|$+[0]" : 0, "\n");      # perl: abbb|4   PCL: 0
    print(("abbbbc" =~ /\N{ 3 , 4 }/) ? "$&|$+[0]" : 0, "\n");  # perl: abbb|4   PCL: 0
  No die: a silent no-match.

perl's rule (perlre / regcomp): after `\N`, a `{` that begins a valid counted quantifier (digits, optional comma, digits, blanks allowed since 5.34) makes `\N` the "not a newline" escape followed by that quantifier; only otherwise is `\N{...}` a named character.
WHERE: the runtime's rewrite scan -- %pcl-rx-escape-end treats `\N{` as ONE unit through the brace and %pcl-rx-escape-text's `\N` arm declines when a `{` follows; also whatever pass handles `\N{NAME}` before the scan (see the %pcl-rx-escape-text docstring).  s499h added %pcl-rx-counted-end (perl's counted grammar); the fix asks it at `\N{`: a counted brace => `[^\n]` + the normalised quantifier.  Guard in Pl/t/regexp-subst-01.t beside #2444's row; companion re/regexp.t is TIMEOUT at ~817 rows (#326), so re_tests row 49 is inside what PCL reaches -- check it moves.


=== DONE (s499k) ===
%pcl-rx-escape-end ends `\N` before a `{` that %pcl-rx-counted-end accepts, and %pcl-rx-escape-text makes such a `\N` `[^\n]`; the scan then writes the braces as a (blank-free) quantifier.  No earlier pass resolves \N{NAME} in a pattern (the docstring claimed one; corrected -- named chars in patterns stay unresolved = #2199).
Probes = perl: \N{3,4} \N{ 3 , 4 } \N{2} \N{,2} \N{3,4}+ \N{3,4}? \N{3,} \N alone, literal + interpolated, s///g, split.  Still different, not this task: \N{U+41} / \N{NAME} (#2199); [\N{3}] \N{a} \N{,} are perl COMPILE errors (principle 9).
Guard: Pl/t/regexp-subst-01.t row 52 (FAILS on 937e7b65).  Companion t/re/regexp.t: re_tests rows 31-40 (\N{1}, \N{3,4}, \N{ 3 , 4 }) now pass, 817/88 -> 824/81 (serial re-run agrees), spliced into baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv.  ir-spec §10-esc2.
subject: SILENT WRONG: `\N{3,4}` / `\N{ 3 , 4 }` (\N quantified by a counted quantifier) never matches -- perl reads the braces as a QUANTIFIER on \N, PCL as a named-character brace
